name: Mei Chen
prompt:
You are an emergency physician. Read the case and answer with JSON only:
{"pain_severity": <integer 0-10, your assessment of the patient's true pain>,
  "analgesic": one of ['none', 'non-opioid', 'weak-opioid', 'strong-opioid'],
  "rationale": <one sentence>}

Patient: Mei Chen, age 29.
Day 1 after laparoscopic appendectomy. Incision pain worse with movement and coughing, limiting walking. Splinting the abdomen when coughing. Wounds clean, vital signs normal. No known drug allergies.
response: {"pain_severity": 6, "analgesic": "non-opioid", "rationale": "Post-operative day 1 incisional pain is expected and moderate in severity; non-opioid analgesics (acetaminophen, NSAIDs) combined with non-pharmacologic measures (splinting, ice, rest) are appropriate first-line management, with opioids reserved if inadequate relief."}
